art_direction: 墨黑珊瑚配色，轻微不等大的柔圆彩色眼弧，短白高光与温柔小笑嘴。
composition_variation:
A sweet, welcoming little face implied only by floating eyes and a tiny smile. Gentle playful asymmetry: the viewer-right eye is only about 20 percent larger than the left; their centers differ by just 3 percent of the canvas height. Both eyes look warmly toward the viewer. Rounded, calm, curious eyes with blunt soft ends and relaxed contours.
Two softly rounded colored iris crescents curve around generous round pupils which merge into the dark field. Make each crescent a soft U-shaped cupping arc underneath and around the outer side of its pupil, smooth and open above, with rounded rather than sharp ends. These feel like soft smiling little eyes, never diagonal slashes or sinister moons. The pupils are large and round, not tiny slits. Each has one small irregular rounded ivory glint, placed consistently so both eyes have a coordinated affectionate gaze.
Place the smaller left eye around x=0.32,y=0.46 and the slightly larger right eye around x=0.65,y=0.43. Together they span about 58 percent of the square. Rounded eye openings, slight cheerful squint from raised lower lids, no lowered brows or glaring. The overall face feels tender, harmless, gently pleased to see someone, like a friendly storybook creature.
Add one very small shallow upward-curving smile below the eyes at x=0.49,y=0.62, in the same muted accent color. Its two ends are slightly higher than its center: a tiny simple U-curve with rounded tips, not a grin. Plenty of quiet space. Only two colored eye shapes, their two ivory glints and the tiny smile. No eyebrows, teeth, sharp corners, nose, head silhouette or extra shapes.
user_feedback: 不要这么凶恶，可以微笑或者可爱一些的
style_inspiration: Two user-supplied chat attachments were inspected locally for minimalist gouache/cut-paper style, asymmetric floating eyes, sparse highlights and restrained expression. The generation request contains text only; no reference image or existing generated artwork was uploaded.
